description: Every bus due at one stop, all routes at once, soonest first: minutes to arrival, where each bus is heading, and the buses after it. Give the stationUID from bus_stops_nearby, or the stop name. Example: city "Taipei", stationUID "TPE1895"; or city "Taipei", stop "臺北車站(鄭州)".

city.description: City: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Keelung, Hsinchu, HsinchuCounty, MiaoliCounty, ChanghuaCounty, NantouCounty, YunlinCounty, ChiayiCounty, Chiayi, PingtungCounty, YilanCounty, HualienCounty, TaitungCounty, KinmenCounty, PenghuCounty, LienchiangCounty) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, ...), or "InterCity" for 公路客運 / 國道客運 coaches between cities.

limit.description: Maximum number of arrivals to return (default 30).

stationUID.description: Station ID from bus_stops_nearby, e.g. "TPE1895" (one side of the street).

stop.description: Exact stop name in Chinese or English, e.g. "臺北車站(鄭州)"; matches the stops of that name on both sides of the street.

name: bus_stop_arrivals
title: Buses arriving at a stop
